arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original DEADWALL source sprite, one complete isolated Composteur de jardin — variante 2.
INPUTS: Image 1 is the authoritative geometry/layout reference rendered by the unchanged game public painter for this exact authored fixture, painter variant 2. Image 2 is MATERIAL AND PAINTERLY STYLE ONLY from the original game atlas; ignore its camera angles, other sprites, grid and background.
CAMERA AND SHAPE: strict orthographic overhead plan, looking vertically downward. Follow image 1 exactly: X points right and Y points down. Preserve its orientation, silhouette, footprint aspect ratio, part count, positions and occlusions. No tilted isometric view or tall exposed facade.
SUBJECT: One complete almost-square timber compost bin in strict overhead plan. Preserve the thick wooden perimeter and dark interior, TWO horizontal dull metal bands at the top and bottom source positions, and the solid rectangular wooden panel covering the LEFT inner portion. That left panel has FOUR short horizontal plank/grain seams, all contained within the panel; they must not span the whole bin. The panel covers the left column of the original source matter, so retain SIX visible small clusters in two columns and three rows on the open right portion. Render those clusters naturally as irregular dry leaves and twig scraps in muted brown and olive, not painted discs, planted crops or collectible stock. No diagonal brace or four full-height vertical members from another variant. No tools, sack, full lid, tall legs, insects, steam or ground pile.
AUTHOR DESIGN ENVELOPE: 1 m across X by 1 m along Y, separate maximum height 1 m. These are game-author design values, not manufacturer measurements. Keep the existing metric proportions; do not redesign the object to fill the canvas.
MATERIALS: grounded serious post-apocalyptic game, restrained detailed hand-painted pre-rendered source art. Follow the canonical variant palette with weathered wood, dull metal and worn stone as applicable; modest grain, small scuffs and soft neutral overhead light. Keep major structural features readable. Idle and unattended, no invented damage or new activity.
OUTPUT: ONE whole object only on true transparent RGBA. Centre the complete silhouette with at least 12 percent clear transparent margin on every side. No crop, detached objects, external ground shadow, ground plane, background scene, UI, lettering, dimensions, logo or watermark. Preserve all thin components. This is a source-art proposal for later calibration, not a claim of metric or pixel-for-pixel certification.

inspection.canonical: Two horizontal metal bands; a left rectangular panel with four short horizontal seams; six matter marks visible on the right in two columns and three rows.
inspection.style: Original Art157 yard atlas inspected again; material/style role only.
